$comment: caseStudyImage names the featured image's media item (the same media id, as a WordPress site stores one attachment ID in both), so it is drawn once, in the hero, and the flow draws nothing between the challenge and the solution: no duplicate and no empty wrapper (SC-034).
summary: A case study whose case-study image is its featured image: the image once, in the header, as the priority image; then the challenge and the solution with nothing between them.

hedge.alt: A newly laid hawthorn hedge, its pleachers bound with hazel

document.title: Laying a field hedge
document.challenge: The hedge had grown into a line of thin trees with gaps at the base.
document.solution: We laid it in the Midland style and planted up the gaps with whips.
